title: Animals
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains what domestic animals give and do for people and names ways of caring for them: food, water, shelter, treatment, kindness.
representations: pictures of a cow, donkey, dog, cat, hen, sheep
pictures of a clean and a dirty shelter
steps: Say what each gives or does.
Name ways of caring for them.
Say what is cruel and why.
contexts: a donkey cart on the road

board.do: Draw a donkey with a very big load.

board.say: Is this caring for the donkey?

board.do: Wait for the child to say no, it is too heavy.

misconceptions.ask: Why do some families keep a donkey?
misconceptions.repair: Make a chart of animals and their uses: donkey carries, dog guards, cat catches rats, ox ploughs.

misconceptions.ask: A donkey stops because its load is too heavy. What should be done?
misconceptions.repair: Discuss how the animal feels. Fair treatment: right load, rest, water.

misconceptions.ask: Does a cow need to be given water every day?
misconceptions.repair: Compare with people: we drink every day. Show a water trough.

misconceptions.ask: A goat stops eating and looks weak. What should the family do?
misconceptions.repair: Name the vet as the doctor for animals. A sick animal can die or spread disease.

checks.question: Name one use of a dog.
Name one way to care for a cow.
checks.answer: Give it water (food, a clean shelter)
